The stock market is a complex and ever-changing system. There are many different factors that can affect the price of a stock, and it can be difficult to predict which way the market will go. However, by using technical analysis, investors can gain insights into the potential direction of the market. 

Moving Averages, MACD, Fibonacci Retracement, Bollinger Bands & RSI are five technical analysis methods that can be used to identify trends and potential trading opportunities.
